name: Vaghani Techno-Build Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Vaghani Techno Build Ltd is in the business of Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) and real estate[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VTBL initially processed, manufactured, and marketed dairy products such as ghee, buttermilk, and condensed milk. Later, it shifted to real estate-related activities and is now entirely focused on TDR (Transfer of Development Rights) trading and real estate development, including projects involving the right to generate TDR.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.96 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 0.60% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 394 days.
